source.installed_release: The retained historical bin/execute 0.8.0 was not modified. No release tag or package was published during this session; session changes remain on main.

scope: Bounded performance session, redirected by the human to loops and then security. Compact Unix glue, native applets and .program control flow retained. Shorthand stayed design-only. No providers invoked during this session.

method.comparisons: Per-pass unchanged-source release baseline versus candidate, identical workload/catalog/inputs/environment, alternating serial samples and independent output oracles. Raw samples, preimages, rejected candidates, hashes and verification logs retained per pass.
method.timing_scopes: Fresh CLI, in-process helpers/runtime APIs, managed socket execution, widget acknowledgement/application and browser worker timings remain distinct. Warm filesystem cache is not cold startup; allocation request traffic is not RSS.
method.non_additive: Each percentage compares its own pass baseline and workload. No cumulative final-versus-initial speedup was measured in final integration; do not add or multiply these percentages.
method.host_limits: Local timing: macOS 26.6.2 arm64 M1 Pro, Rust 1.99, uncontrolled background activity. Actual Chromium measurements are identified in the browser pass. Native Linux/Windows performance, true cold-cache startup, peak memory/RSS and universal Bash superiority are unproved.

selected_measured_results.result: Decode median 50.9% lower; load 12.5% lower. Load allocation requests 1487→658; requested bytes 143356→59805. Fresh CLI controls approximately flat. Strict legacy decoding compatibility checked across about4000 nodes.
Supplied-input parse ~86%, resolution ~80%, argument validation ~66% lower in process;two CLI repeats ~27–33% lower. Up to 64-input CLI cases remain within 1%. Index storage tradeoff retained.

Four-MiB requested allocation traffic 16786257→12590674bytes in three identical repeats. Fresh CLI/listener controls approximately flat; separate input-setup pass retained in index.

selected_measured_results.scope: 32 pure JSON nodes with1–4 MiB state, actual local control plane
selected_measured_results.result: State handoff pass:1 MiB about4% and4 MiB7.5–7.9% lower;small controls flat. No allocation/RSS gain inferred.
Allocation calls 1066→65 and requested bytes 132916→4788. Actual fresh-CLI completed resume remains within 1.2%; no whole-task speedup claimed. Identity bytes and durability semantics retained.

selected_measured_results.scope: Actual WASM in Node and Chromium worker, trace-heavy fixtures
selected_measured_results.result: Trace-heavy Chromium worker operation medians ~21–32% lower; roundtrip ~21–26% lower in retained repeats. Small cases quantized or flat. WASM grows 909 bytes. No native process or provider timing claim.

selected_measured_results.scope: Real4 MiB table edits, full-frame/state oracles; each trial sums eight edits
selected_measured_results.result: Separate successive passes report edit-to-applied medians ~2.1–2.4%, 5.9–6.2%, and 7.3–7.6% lower against their respective baselines. These are distinct results, not an aggregate. Socket observation includes scheduling/Python overhead and is not event-to-photon. The handoff pass acknowledgement is ~1% higher and an unchanged validation microcontrol ~40 ns slower.

selected_measured_results.scope: Private callback helper plus actual cat stream controls
selected_measured_results.result: Complete 8-byte record helper median ~53% lower;actual cat tasks within 2%,so no broad task gain claimed. Fragmented/error pending-byte semantics retained. Unchanged cron microcontrol ~2–3 ns slower is disclosed.

requested_feature.loops: repeat, for each and scalar-equality while in native/browser shared grammar; typed outer updates, local iteration scope, 64 combined nesting limit and 100,000 shared iteration guard. Whole-loop checkpoint/live nodes preserve explicit uncertain-effect retry; no per-iteration resume.
requested_feature.verification: 11 native loop integration cases, shared runtime/parser regressions, editor grammar and browser contracts. Existing loop commit cross-platformCI passed. Final source full regression verification below includes loops.

security.result: Owned baseline symlink returns canary bytes and FIFO blocks. Final rejects linked roots/files, special files, unsafe Unix owner/mode bits; new Unix directories 0700, entries 0600. Raw byte/key compatibility retained and invalid cache fails before native launch or later save.
security.cost: Two matched cached-listener repeats add roughly 0.8–2.1% acknowledgement latency; accepted security cost.

security.result: Fixed monotonic transport budget stops per-byte renewal. Baseline stayed alive beyond 2.5 s after an acknowledged stop while partial data arrived;candidate exited normally about 1.7 s after stop. Full document unchanged on expired incomplete mutation. Valid 2200 ms handler wait still succeeds.

Follow-up actual CLI revealed macOS blocking write could outlive SO_SNDTIMEO. Explicit nonblocking guard plus remaining-budget polling and flag restoration now expires around 2.02 s despite continuing drain;previous 969ad7b client still alive at 3.51 s. CLI response reads remain ~12 s.
security.cost: Two paired 4 MiB healthy RPC repeats 16.57%/16.85% slower,about 6.6→7.7 ms. Empty reply variation +10.2%/-34.5% is not attributed. Accepted security cost, not a speedup.

rejections_and_corrections: Pass 04 manifest decoder experiment was parked, not shipped. Final pass 05 rejects broadened sequence acceptance and preserves the legacy map-only contract.
Compact input-index experiment reduced allocation traffic but made parsing consistently ~3.7–3.8% slower; rejected and original source restored.
Earlier preflight overwrite and tiny stream-fragment regressions were refined before acceptance; earlier raw data and sources retained.
MSG_DONTWAIT-only live transport candidate blocked an unread-peer unit on this host; rejected and exact owned test/cargo/shell terminated. Final explicit O_NONBLOCK guard passes.
A stale core executable was rejected by catalog identity before candidate timing; failed pairing excluded and current Cargo artifact selected explicitly.

Fixture corrections retained: deterministic middle-stage failure must drain bounded stdin to avoid legitimate upstream SIGPIPE; short macOS Unix socket path before renaming; expired partial request may close/reset instead of delivering an error frame; 969ad7b baseline already enforces 12 s response read.

remaining_gaps: No enforced command sandbox or capabilities. Scripts, manifests, executables and same-user live clients remain trusted and inherit caller permissions.
Cache/checkpoint ancestor races, same-user tampering, cache authentication, Unix extended ACL inspection and equivalent Windows cache ACL enforcement remain open.

Established live wire deadlines do not bound connection setup, CPU/mutex handling, filesystem operations or arbitrary stdout consumers. Windows dynamic slow-peer timing is unverified by these Unix probes.
Bulk live reply security cost is a future measurement target;any improvement must retain deadlines, byte caps, peer checks and cleanup.
No cumulative final-versus-initial performance claim, true cold-cache/RSS study, native Linux/Windows timing or exhaustion-of-all-feasible-optimizations claim.
Full Bash/Omarchy compatibility, real desktop acceptance, modules/jobs/concurrency, richer redirection and structured streams remain project proof gates.

Held-out 100-real-Bash-script model generation/repair/readability study remains open. Existing 150 utilities and 100 model fixture workflows do not replace it. No provider inference, accuracy or prompt-injection security claim.
